text.text_excerpt: For me, this is the best place to stay in the Quarter. It is very unique which added to the appeal. It is like staying at your friend's mansion. I loved the main sitting area and the staircase leading up to our room. Our room was split level and had a king size bed, living area, quaint private balcony that looked onto the courtyard, and 1.5 bath. Everything in the French Quarter is in walking distance. It is a block or so from Bourbon St, so you don't really have outside noise when trying to sleep. I enjoyed drinking the coffee with the complimentary Biscotti and Biscoff on our little patio. The staff are very friendly. I can't imagine staying anywhere else.

We stopped here for our one night in NOLA. We loved this hotel. It is such a unique and interesting place. We were greeted and invited to explore the grounds. We walked throughout the hotel/house and courtyard/grounds. Every area was unique, picturesque, romantic, beautiful, and interesting. We even found a small courtyard with grill that appeared to be set up to grill close to poolside if you wanted. Our room was 213. It was a split level with the master bedroom and private half bath upstairs in a loft area. The downstairs was a sitting room with fold outer couch and full bathroom (shower) The room had all the modern upgrades (rain shower, AC, TV, mini fridge, coffee pot, private safe......

I have absolutely no complaints about this place. Conveniently located a block off of Bourbon Street, this nook of a hotel has charm and character. Authentic creole decor and a beautiful courtyard with a fountain and pool really tie this place together. The rooms are quirky, but definitely reflect the design of old New Orleans. The staff is accommodating and friendly. While parking is interesting, it beats paying jacked up prices elsewhere. Feel free to use the pool after-hours - but mind sleeping guests with their rooms adjacent to the patio! This is an ideal stop for a couple or small group looking to make the most of their French Quarter experience. Within very comfortable walking dist...
